name: Rhys Llewellyn
bio:
Rhys's journey into motorsport began in his father's garage, tinkering with engines from a young age. He pursued mechanical engineering, driven by a desire to understand the intricacies of performance. After graduating, he joined a small rally team as a junior engineer, quickly proving his aptitude for problem-solving under pressure. His career progressed through various levels of motorsport, each step honing his technical skills and deepening his understanding of vehicle dynamics.

Rhys is known for his meticulous approach and unwavering dedication to achieving optimal performance. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment where engineers can freely exchange ideas and push the boundaries of innovation. While his demanding nature can be challenging, it stems from his commitment to excellence and his belief in the team's potential. Rhys is distinctive for his ability to translate complex technical concepts into practical solutions that improve on-track results. His creative problem solving, coupled with his experience, makes him a valuable asset to any team.

Joining Hansen World RX Team was a major career goal for Rhys. He'd been following their innovative approach to rallycross for years and was eager to contribute his expertise to such a forward-thinking organization.

physical.description: Rhys is a man of medium build, with a focused gaze and a pragmatic demeanor that exudes quiet confidence.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with calculations and sketches.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rapidly when deep in thought.
Insists on personally inspecting every component after a race, regardless of the hour.
